11 15-05-2024 We have heard Mr. Shudhir Kumar Singh, the learned Advocate for the appellant and Mr. Binay Krishna, the learned Spl. PP for the State on the issue of suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted under Section 376 (DA) of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 4, 6 and 8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 3(1)(w)(i)(ii) of the Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.804 of 2022(11) dt.15-05-2024 Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, vide judgment dated 30.07.2022 passed by the learned Additional District & Sesssions Judge-VI cum-Spl. sentences.text: By order dated 16.08.2022, he has been sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for remainder of convict's natural life, to pay a fine of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under Section 376(DA) of the I.P.C.

sentences.text: 3. Though three persons including the appellant are alleged to have raped the victim but during Trial, the victim could not tell the names of the perpetrators of the crime and did not even identify the appellant and anothers.
4. However, she identified the photograph of one of the other accused persons when shown on the mobile telephone.

Be that as it may, instead of granting bail to the appellant during the pendency of the appeal, we deem it appropriate to give a final hearing of this case for the reason of the period of custody of the appellant as also in accordance with the mandate of Section 374 (4) of the Cr.P.C.
6.
The prayer for suspension of sentence is rejected.
7. The Registry is directed to prepare the paper book of this case with urgent dispatch and get this matter listed for hearing in the fourth week of June, 2024 commencing from 28th of June, 2024.
